import re
from collections import Counter

def word_count_ascii(text):
    words = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z]+', text)
    lowered = (w.lower() for w in words)
    counts = Counter(lowered)
    return sorted([[word, cnt] for word, cnt in counts.items()])
